findings.text: the reviewed manifest files its gate logs under test_logs rather than the dispatch contract's baseline_suite/after_suite JSON fields, so the promotion path's annotate_review_of_run (reckon/crew/review.py:1762) finds no baseline_suite/after_suite field and derives added_failure_count as unmeasured rather than 0; the two gate logs exist and both show zero failures, so the count is recoverable from the logs the manifest does name.

the head-arm log's first line names revision 24c8efb59 (the base commit) while the change is at 410cec8d15, so recorded_log_revision(head_text) returns the base sha and the stored head_log_revision contradicts reviewed_head_sha; the head arm demonstrably ran at head (215 passed = 211 base + the 4 new tests, and its command names the new test file), so the header revision is mislabelled rather than the arm misplaced.

the generated JSON schema was written although it was outside the node's seven-path declaration; it is a regenerated artifact required to keep the byte-identical schema round-trip in tests/test_flight.py green, and the manifest's follow_ons names it for the schema owner to accept or re-drive.

item_verdicts.diff: Read line by line. budget_group.py adds all_members_review_excluded and reserve_block_for_group and routes group_figures through it; dispatch_admission.py routes the bookend-reserve refusal through reserve_block_for_group; the pydantic model and JSON schema are regenerated from the LinkML source. The two surfaces a reader consults (the wallet's group_figures report and the dispatch refusal) both move, so the lift is not confined to one path.
item_verdicts.done_when: I reproduced each bullet at head 410cec8d. Reserve of 0 on an all-excluded wallet: tests/test_bookend_reserve_by_group.py test_a_wallet_with_no_review_capable_member_withholds_no_reserve asserts figures.reserve_pct == 0.0. Full-ceiling implement dispatch: test_an_implement_dispatch_reaches_the_full_ceiling_on_such_a_wallet admits the implement dispatch at utilisation 0.85 past the 0.75 boundary and refuses the same reading on the review-capable wallet. Configured reserve derived at assertion time: the review-capable half reads float(config['budget'][reserve.RESERVE_KEY]) rather than a literal. Schema accepts the key and it moves the boundary: test_a_flight_layer_writes_the_key_and_moves_the_boundary resolves a layer writing bookend_reserve_pct: 35 and asserts role_ceiling_pct(implement) == 65. I ran the file at head: 4 passed EXIT=0. Negative control: I applied the declared mutation (rv all_members_review_excluded -> False) in a scratch tree and the two all-excluded cases reddened while the other two stayed green (2 failed, 2 passed, EXIT=1). Config isolation: every case runs under the guarded_home fixture, which points RECKON_HOME at a throwaway tree and asserts the real home's file census and content digests are unchanged after the case.
item_verdicts.goal: The node carries plan §11: budget_group.all_members_review_excluded (reckon/crew/budget_group.py:136) reads the declared wallet's members and the configuration's review_excluded_backends, and reserve_block_for_group (budget_group.py:163) zeroes RESERVE_KEY on the block a wallet whose every member is excluded is judged through; group_figures (budget_group.py:354) and the dispatch refusal (reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:312) both judge through it, so a wallet that cannot serve a review withholds no bookend reserve and an implement dispatch reaches the group's full ceiling rather than the reserved fraction.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records the head gate 215 passed EXIT=0, the base arm 211 passed EXIT=0 (zero added failures), the negative control red (2 failed, EXIT=1), commits 410cec8d, and changed_paths matching the diff exactly. Two manifest-shape gaps are named as findings below: the gate logs are filed under test_logs rather than the contract's baseline_suite/after_suite fields, and the head-arm log's own first line names the base revision.
item_verdicts.write_paths: git show --name-only 410cec8d lists seven paths: reckon/schema/flight.yaml, reckon/_flight_schema.py, reckon/crew/budget_group.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py, tests/test_bookend_reserve_by_group.py, docs/_shared/flight.schema.json, docs/evidence/fragments/a-window-paces-the-lane/a-review-excluded-group-withholds-no-reserve.html. Six are inside the node's declared write paths; docs/_shared/flight.schema.json is the generated schema, outside the declaration, which the manifest's own follow_ons names rather than hides.

All-excluded wallet reports 0 and reaches the ceiling: the new test file's test_a_wallet_with_no_review_capable_member_withholds_no_reserve asserts reserve_pct == 0.0 and test_an_implement_dispatch_reaches_the_full_ceiling_on_such_a_wallet admits the implement dispatch at utilisation 0.85 past the 0.75 reserve boundary while refusing the same reading on the review-capable wallet. Review-capable wallet reports the configured reserve derived at assertion time from the resolved configuration. A flight layer writing bookend_reserve_pct: 35 is accepted and moves the implement ceiling to 65. I ran tests/test_bookend_reserve_by_group.py at head: 4 passed EXIT=0. Negative control: applying the declared mutation in a scratch tree reddened exactly the two all-excluded cases (2 failed, 2 passed, EXIT=1), which I reproduced independently. Config isolation: every case runs under a fixture that redirects RECKON_HOME to a throwaway tree and asserts the real home is byte-unchanged afterwards.
VERDICT write_paths: git show --name-only 410cec8d lists seven paths; six lie inside the node's declared write paths, and docs/_shared/flight.schema.json is a regenerated artifact outside the declaration, named in the manifest's own follow_ons.
VERDICT manifest: read; head gate 215 passed EXIT=0, base arm 211 passed EXIT=0, negative control 2 failed EXIT=1, commits 410cec8d, changed_paths match the diff. The gate logs are filed under test_logs rather than baseline_suite/after_suite, so the wrapped added-failure derivation reads unmeasured rather than 0.
VERDICT diff: read line by line; both surfaces a reader consults (group_figures and the dispatch refusal) move through reserve_block_for_group, and the schema slot is declared in the LinkML source with the pydantic model and JSON schema regenerated.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/budget_group.py:354 group_figures -> reserve_block_for_group, reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:312 _refuse_against_the_bookend_reserve -> budget_group.reserve_block_for_group, reckon/crew/budget_group.py:178 reserve_block_for_group -> all_members_review_excluded
SCORE goal_fidelity: 20
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: every one of the four done-when bullets is implemented and covered, and both the wallet's own report (group_figures) and the dispatch refusal judge through the single reserve_block_for_group so the lift is not confined to one surface.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: I reproduced the head gate (4 passed) and the negative control (2 failed) independently at 410cec8d, but the head-arm log's first line names the base revision and the manifest omits the contract's baseline_suite/after_suite fields, so the stored evidence carries two shape defects a reader must work around.
SCORE scope_discipline: 18
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the diff is seven paths, six inside the declaration; the seventh, the generated JSON schema, is outside it but honestly disclosed in the manifest's follow_ons rather than hidden.
SCORE durability: 20
JUSTIFICATION durability: the negative control makes the all-excluded predicate false and reddens exactly the two all-excluded cases while the review-capable and schema cases stay green, so the guarded behaviour is shown to be the thing under test; expectations are read from the configuration at assertion time and every case watches the real config home.
SCORE fit: 20
JUSTIFICATION fit: the change sits in budget_group beside the grouping it depends on, the slot is declared in schema/flight.yaml and the pydantic model is regenerated from it, and no plan, stage or ticket label appears in the changed source or tests.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the change reuses the existing reserve module and the recovery module's own exclusion reader rather than re-deriving the exclusion list, and adds one predicate and one block helper instead of a second reserve implementation.
